lines.text: Walk to work, not by walk!
Many learners say: I go to work by walk.
We walk to work, we do not go by walk.

data.wrong: I go to work by walk.
data.why: We walk to work, we do not go by walk.

native.hook: เดินไป ใช้ walk ไม่ใช่ by walk!
native.tip: by bus, by car ได้ แต่ by walk ไม่ได้ ใช้กริยา walk: “I walk to work”
native.caption: คุณเคยพูดว่า “I go to work by walk.” ไหม? 😅 เราพูด by bus, by car ได้ แต่ไม่พูด by walk ต้องใช้กริยา walk (หรือ on foot): “I walk to work.” ฟังครู Ama แล้วพูดตามนะ! ฝึกเพิ่มในแอป Lexkite

en.tip: We say by bus or by car, but not by walk. Use the verb: “I walk to work”
en.caption: Do you say “I go to work by walk”? 😅 We say by bus and by car, but not by walk. Use the verb walk. Say “I walk to work”! Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
